snippet.title: The Fourth Protocol
snippet.description:
Finally a computer game genre for the most jaded player:  Desk Jockeying.  

You are John Preston and you are a member of some British spy agency.  Your job is to spy on people during the Cold War.  Your goal is to manage your spies while maintaining your file cabinet and reading memos.  Take that, PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, and Wii U!

This is only the first chapter.  The second chapter allows you to leave your office and use items.  The third chapter needs a password and I think has to do with a bomb.  

Yes, as a matter of fact I DO like to post videos about obscure games.   I still don't completely understand this game.  My dad picked a few bargain C64 games at random.
